items.claim: Gate: write a context manager and a decorator; what __hash__ must guarantee
Execution model: refcounting + cycle GC, sys.getrefcount, __del__ unreliable, weak references

items.status: verified (k1_gil on 3.14 and 3.14t); corrected: free-threaded experimental from 3.13, supported from 3.14

items.claim: Three concurrency models and when each applies; costs (thread stacks, pickling, event-loop starvation)
asyncio in depth: coroutines are objects, event loop, await yields, TaskGroup and asyncio.timeout, cancellation, never block the loop (run_in_executor), async for/async with
Descriptors and attribute lookup chain; property, classmethod, methods are descriptors
Metaclasses and __init_subclass__: reach for __init_subclass__ first
Performance: profile before optimising (cProfile, py-spy, timeit, memray/tracemalloc); algorithm, then vectorise, then native; str concat quadratic
items.status: verified (p1_profile, py-spy refusal, scalene, tracemalloc in g3/c3); memray not run
